newsitem.title: USA: FirstCity Financial ends investment pact.
newsitem.headline: FirstCity Financial ends investment pact.

text.p: FirstCity Financial Corp said on Tuesday that it has ended its investment management agreement with FirstCity Liquidating Trust, under which FirstCity Financial has been providing servicing for the Trust's assets since July 1995.
The company said the Liquidating Trust paid it $6.8 million in settlement for future estimated fees payable under the agreement, which will be reflected in FirstCity's first quarter 1997 earnings.
Effective with the termination, servicing responsibilities for the assets will be transferred to the Liquidating Trust in Houston, the company said.

"The relationship between the Trust and FirstCity has always been somewhat confusing," the company said in a statement. "This transaction should allow us to further clarify our corporate identity, and to devote all of our efforts to the pursuit of investment activities integral to our business plan."
